title: Hangin' at the Hangar Bar -- A Disney Adults Podcast
author: Scott Minks
description: Pull up a chair with Scott and Candice, a Disney-loving married couple who have been visiting Walt Disney World together for decades. Hangin' at the Hangar Bar is a Disney podcast for adults who love the parks, food, resorts, cruises, movies, history, nostalgia, and all the wonderfully ridiculous conversations that come with being a Disney fan. We're not a news show. We're longtime Disney adults who still love the magic but aren't afraid to question it. Grab a drink and join the conversation!
